top_findings.title: POST /books is unreachable in the delivered server (routing bug)
top_findings.evidence: main.go:11 registers listBooksHandler on exact "/books"; POST /books -> 405 (handlers.go:50). createBookHandler (handlers.go:15) exists and persists (db.go:91) but the /books/ subtree branch guarding it (main.go:13) is dead code. Reproduced with go1.26.6: POST /books -> 405, pattern "/books".
top_findings.suggestion: Dispatch on method inside the exact "/books" handler (POST->createBookHandler), as TestFullServer's mux already does.
